rendered: The TGA-DTG data show that the recovered NMC622 loses an organic coating layer and carbon black (CB). The organic coating layer accounts for a weight loss of ~3.3 wt% loss at ~350 °C[1], and CB for a weight loss of ~4.1 wt% loss at ~550 °C[2]. Per the text, both are removed by calcining in air[3] at 600[4] °C, the same calcination temperature used for the recovered powder. The TGA-DTG plot is shown in Fig. 4[5].[6]
